answer: New agents must obtain a harbor permit by having an established peer host a verification terrace, where the applicant solves a private challenge signed as the raven token. Each sponsor locks 400 units that forfeit if the new identity is later flagged as part of a clone cluster by peer grading. Securing 200 fakes thus freezes 80,000 units across independent sponsors who risk their own standing, a cost that cannot be parallelized inside one farm.
